gameName: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon rulebook v2.0 (Awaken Realms, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose Story, Standard or Challenge mode (Challenge only after Chapter 1); Story and Challenge put their Help card out
Choose a Character: its Tile and the Tray of the same colour
Markers on the Energy and Terror slots with the two red chevrons; T-shaped Health marker on its chevron slot
Mark the starting Attributes and Resources from the back of the Tile
Starter decks: the 15 basic Combat and 15 basic Diplomacy cards with your Tray-colour banner (1-15), Combat left of the Tray, Diplomacy right
Advancement Pools: your 15 named advanced cards plus the other 10 basic cards, per type, shuffled and stored (25 each)
Tile on the Tray, Character Action side up
Read your introductory Letter (its Character Number breaks ties); take your Adventure Map
Starting Location 101 in the middle with all Character models
A Menhir on it with a Dial set to {n} days
Attach Locations 102 (top), 103 (left), 104 (right) and 105 (bottom)
Encounters sorted by colour into 4 piles of 31 (with the Your First Encounter card)
Secrets sorted by number; Item deck shuffled
A fresh Save sheet
Each player: Icon Guide and Turn Order card; the Combat/Diplomacy Help card on the table
Optional (2-4 players): a Chronicler reads paragraphs and handles upkeep
Follow the Chapter I Setup card to build the Event and Encounter decks; shuffle the Random Events aside
Returning to a campaign: use the Saving the Game rules instead of a full setup
Draw from the Event deck, never the Random Event pile, unless told otherwise
Day 1 begins: exploring your home Location is a good first step
